description_target.target_text: Each row shows a nonzero prefix that is itself built from a smaller repeating unit. Recover the shortest repeating seed for that prefix, then tile that seed across the full row width.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define dirs4 (list (list -1 0) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1) (list 0 1)))
    (define (cell< a b)
      (if (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)) (< (first a) (first b))))
    (define (fifth xs) (list-ref xs 4))
    (define (drop xs n) (if (<= n 0) xs (drop (rest xs) (- n 1))))
    (define (list-set xs idx val)
      (let loop ([rest-xs xs] [i 0])
        (if (empty? rest-xs)
            (list)
            (cons (if (= i idx) val (first rest-xs))
                  (loop (rest rest-xs) (+ i 1))))))
    (define (obj-r1 obj) (first (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (obj-c1 obj) (second (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (obj-r2 obj) (third (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (obj-c2 obj) (fourth (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (paint grid cells color)
      (for/fold ([out grid]) ([p (in-list cells)])
        (if (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) (rows out) (cols out))
            (set-cell out (first p) (second p) color)
            out)))
    (define (row-run r start end color)
      (list 'row r start end (+ 1 (- end start)) color
            (for/list ([c (in-range start (+ end 1))]) (list r c))))
    (define (col-run c start end color)
      (list 'col c start end (+ 1 (- end start)) color
            (for/list ([r (in-range start (+ end 1))]) (list r c))))
    (define (run-line run) (second run))
    (define (run-start run) (third run))
    (define (run-end run) (fourth run))
    (define (run-length run) (fifth run))
    (define (run-color run) (list-ref run 5))
    (define (run-cells run) (list-ref run 6))
    (define (row-runs grid)
      (apply append
             (for/list ([r (in-range (rows grid))])
               (let loop ([c 0] [acc (list)])
                 (if (>= c (cols grid))
                     (reverse acc)
                     (let ((v (at grid r c)))
                       (if (= v 0)
                           (loop (+ c 1) acc)
                           (let find-end ([cc c])
                             (if (and (< (+ cc 1) (cols grid)) (= (at grid r (+ cc 1)) v))
                                 (find-end (+ cc 1))
                                 (loop (+ cc 1) (cons (row-run r c cc v) acc)))))))))))
    (define (col-runs grid)
      (apply append
             (for/list ([c (in-range (cols grid))])
               (let loop ([r 0] [acc (list)])
                 (if (>= r (rows grid))
                     (reverse acc)
                     (let ((v (at grid r c)))
                       (if (= v 0)
                           (loop (+ r 1) acc)
                           (let find-end ([rr r])
                             (if (and (< (+ rr 1) (rows grid)) (= (at grid (+ rr 1) c) v))
                                 (find-end (+ rr 1))
                                 (loop (+ rr 1) (cons (col-run c r rr v) acc)))))))))))
    (define (full-bar-col grid color)
      (first (filter (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (= (at grid r c) color)) (range (rows grid)))) (range (cols grid)))))
    (define (prefix-nonzero row)
      (let loop ([i 0] [acc (list)])
        (if (or (>= i (length row)) (= (list-ref row i) 0))
            (reverse acc)
            (loop (+ i 1) (cons (list-ref row i) acc)))))
    (define (repeat-to-length pattern len)
      (if (empty? pattern)
          (make-list len 0)
          (for/list ([i (in-range len)]) (list-ref pattern (modulo i (length pattern))))))
    (define (smallest-period seq)
      (let* ((n (length seq))
             (cands (filter
                     (lambda (p)
                       (and (= (modulo n p) 0)
                            (all? (lambda (i) (= (list-ref seq i) (list-ref seq (modulo i p)))) (range n))))
                     (range 1 (+ n 1)))))
        (take seq (first cands))))
    (define (without-positions grid cells)
      (for/fold ([out grid]) ([p (in-list cells)])
        (set-cell out (first p) (second p) 0)))
    (define (row-signature-cells cells)
      (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
             (r1 (first bb)) (c1 (second bb)) (r2 (third bb)))
        (for/list ([r (in-range r1 (+ r2 1))])
          (sort (map (lambda (p) (- (second p) c1))
                     (filter (lambda (p) (= (first p) r)) cells))
                <))))
    (define (crop-cells grid cells)
      (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
        (subgrid grid (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb))))
    (define (same-residue-values grid th tw rr cc)
      (filter values
              (for*/list ([r (in-range (rows grid))] [c (in-range (cols grid))])
                (let ((v (at grid r c)))
                  (if (and (not (= v 0)) (= (modulo r th) rr) (= (modulo c tw) cc)) v #f)))))
    (define (tile-dims-valid? grid th tw)
      (all?
       (lambda (rc)
         (let* ((rr (first rc)) (cc (second rc)) (vals (same-residue-values grid th tw rr cc)))
           (and (not (empty? vals)) (all? (lambda (v) (= v (first vals))) vals))))
       (for*/list ([r (in-range th)] [c (in-range tw)]) (list r c))))
    (define (infer-tile grid)
      (let* ((cands (filter (lambda (dims) (tile-dims-valid? grid (first dims) (second dims)))
                            (for*/list ([th (in-range 1 (+ (min 5 (rows grid)) 1))]
                                        [tw (in-range 1 (+ (min 5 (cols grid)) 1))])
                              (list th tw))))
             (dims (first cands))
             (th (first dims))
             (tw (second dims)))
        (for/list ([r (in-range th)])
          (for/list ([c (in-range tw)])
            (first (same-residue-values grid th tw r c))))))

    (for/list ([row (in-list g)])
      (let ((period (smallest-period (prefix-nonzero row))))
        (repeat-to-length period (length row))))
  ))
